title: ScheduledTaskPatch
description: Authoring shape for updateSchedule (partial PATCH). Every field is optional; at least one MUST be present (minProperties). Only client-mutable fields are accepted — name, cron, persona_id, action, and status (enabled|disabled toggle, per Schedules.md). Immutable/derived fields (id, created_at, updated_at, last_run_at, next_run_at) are forbidden. Sub-schemas are $ref'd from scheduled-task.json so they cannot drift. Normative.
